description: The proving run of the resilient mesh on Linode (C-operations 7), on deploy/low-latency/topology-proving.json (three serving edges and one standby a region, two forwarders and a dist-c slot, two contributors): every change kind of C CL7 as one held step of opus-1 listeners, each scenario with probes of its own on every view host on opus-1 and pcm-1 (probe_configs, published beside the crowd's) and scored alone by the referee's change-window.py on its own marks (pass may be null; null_fail_rate reported). Groups in order: N (the deployed null), U (rolls and the upgrade), F (crashes and A's changes), R (replace), A (the autoscaler's verbs and the controller alone). scale-run.py run --phase-plan deploy/low-latency/phases-proving.json --group N|U|F|R|A --budget-usd 60 [--next-av-mesh-root ... for U4]. Listener figures are listeners: two-path listeners are two legs each (C 2.11, B 3.6). U3, C1 and C2 wait for workstream A's two contributors and its kill and return on the deploy tool (scripts/contributor_changes.py): run them by name. The engine's timeouts are given to every gated command (gate 10 s, drain 15 s, readiness 30 s: B's drain bound is 3 s + 4 r and a 5 s grace, C 3.4's warm-up a few seconds) because a scenario's probes are planned from them: they run about twice its bound beyond its change. deploy/low-latency/SCALE.md, section 'The proving run', has the sizing, the time and the cost.

scenarios.name: N1
scenarios.title: roll all, dry: the deployed null (every gate for real, nothing restarted)

scenarios.name: U1
scenarios.title: roll edges (the same build): every edge restarted once, the surge edges back on standby

open.criterion: the surge edges back on standby after the roll
open.needs: the deploy record's standby_edges read after the roll (not in the samplers)

scenarios.name: U3
scenarios.title: roll contributors (after workstream A)
scenarios.note: Runs by name (--scenarios U3) once workstream A's two contributors and its gate are deployed.

scenarios.name: U4
scenarios.title: upgrade all to the next build

open.criterion: every node on the target build (its git id) each way
open.needs: the git ids of the run's roots beside the nodes' /api/node build; judged now as one build after the change

scenarios.name: U5
scenarios.title: upgrade all back to the first build

open.criterion: every node on the target build (its git id) each way
open.needs: the git ids of the run's roots beside the nodes' /api/node build; judged now as one build after the change

open.criterion: leases back within 500 ms of the forwarder's first hello
open.needs: lease timing finer than the 1 s mesh sampler (the node's own lease events)

open.criterion: leases back within 500 ms of the forwarder's first hello
open.needs: lease timing finer than the 1 s mesh sampler (the node's own lease events)

scenarios.name: C1
scenarios.title: restart contrib-lon through workstream A's gate and readiness
scenarios.note: Runs by name once workstream A lands (two contributors, contrib_gate and contrib_ready).

scenarios.name: C2
scenarios.title: kill contrib-lon (A's kill, held down) and its return
scenarios.note: Runs by name once the deploy tool has workstream A's kill and return (A 2.10); the return is the restore.

scenarios.name: RP1
scenarios.title: replace new-edge-1 by a rebuild: no other node restarted, both addresses kept

open.criterion: both addresses as recorded after the rebuild
open.needs: the lab state's public and VLAN addresses of new-edge-1 compared before and after the replace

scenarios.name: RP2
scenarios.title: replace tok-dist-b by a rebuild, through tok-dist-c: the slot created, warm, removed

open.criterion: the slot created, warm before it clears its bit, removed, within the budget
open.needs: the deploy tool's replace journal (slot, warm, bit, delete) and the lab tool's ledger, read after the replace

scenarios.name: A1p
scenarios.title: the controller alone: 75, 150, 225 listeners a region; the standby joins (the first controller), then the next run creates edge-5 (the first create by the controller on Linode)

scenarios.name: A2p
scenarios.title: the controller alone: 225 to 37 listeners a region; it drains to its edges and deletes the slot

scenarios.name: A3p
scenarios.title: forwarders, K = 2, London: lon-dist-c created, joined warm, drained, gated, stopped

scenarios.name: A4p
scenarios.title: the controller running; lon-edge-2 killed and its unit masked (held down): lost from in-mesh evidence, replace_join within 12 s

open.needs: a controller that runs on past replace_join (run --until join returns there)
